title: Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued September 18, 2019
主要内容: On September 18, 2019, the Federal Reserve Board issued an Implementation Note outlining decisions to implement the monetary policy stance announced by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). The Board of Governors voted unanimously to lower the interest rate paid on required and excess reserve balances to 1.80 percent, effective September 19, 2019. This rate was set 20 basis points below the top of the target range for the federal funds rate to foster trading within the FOMC's target range. The FOMC also authorized the Open Market Desk at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York to execute transactions in the System Open Market Account, maintaining the federal funds rate in a target range of 1-3/4 to 2 percent. The Desk was directed to conduct overnight reverse repurchase operations at an offering rate of 1.70 percent, with reinvestment limits based on Treasury securities holdings and a $30 billion per day counterparty limit. Additionally, the Board approved a 1/4 percentage point decrease in the primary credit rate to 2.50 percent, effective September 19, 2019. The Federal Reserve Board issued an Implementation Note on September 18, 2019, outlining details regarding the implementation of monetary policy measures. This note was published on the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's website and reflects the latest updates as of that date. The document provides guidance on the operational aspects of policy decisions made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). It is important for market participants and financial institutions to review this note to understand the implications of recent policy actions. The note does not include any specific stock recommendations or financial forecasts, focusing instead on procedural and regulatory clarity.
